verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents sending follow-up messages or instructions to a running Devin session. The closest items are adjacent controls: manually taking over in Devin's IDE after a first draft, stepping into the Interactive Browser, generic 'session management' via MCP, and auto-fix responses to code review comments. None of these shows a developer issuing new instructions mid-session to redirect the agent without restarting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send follow-up instructions to an active agent session to steer its work without restarting
